description: Unified catalog for all data and AI assets in commit-relay system. Implements Databricks-proven governance patterns with three-level namespace (catalog.schema.asset).

coordination.description: Coordination layer data assets - tasks, handoffs, routing decisions

tasks.description: Task management data including pending, active, and completed tasks

memory.description: Working and long-term memory for system learning

masters.description: Master agent AI assets - contexts, knowledge bases, states

workers.description: Worker agent AI assets - specifications and execution data

moe.description: Mixture of Experts routing system assets

prompts.description: AI prompt templates and agent definitions
